name: com.bizsim.google.play.assetdelivery
description: Unity package for Google Play Asset Delivery API (v2.3.0). On-demand, fast-follow, and install-time asset packs with per-pack state streaming, cellular confirmation, batch fetch, retry policy, and Addressables integration.

samples.description: BasicFetch + OnDemandLevelLoader + CellularConfirmation samples covering the three delivery modes.
14 pre-configured mock scenarios covering install-time, fast-follow, on-demand, cellular confirmation, and error paths.
